newsitem.title: USA: Enova, PET ask FERC to speed review.
newsitem.headline: Enova, PET ask FERC to speed review.

text.p: Following a decision Wednesday by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to review Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises's planned merger, the companies asked FERC to expedite the review under the 150-day processing time outlined in its recent merger policy statement.

"We are disappointed that the FERC did not approve our petition to disclaim jurisdiction, but we are confident that their formal review will show our merger meets the agency's criteria for approval: no adverse impact on wholesale rates, wholesale competition or on state regulation," said Bill Reed, vice president for regulatory affairs at Enova.
Enova, parent of San Diego Gas & Electric Co, and Pacific Enterprises, parent of Southern California Gas Co., announced last October plans to merge in a deal valued at $5.2 billion.
The companies had filed for exemption from FERC review since the regulatory agency's authority over gas and electric combinations was unclear.
But FERC said Wednesday it does have authority, under the Federal Power Act, to review such "convergence" mergers.
As a back-up measure, Enova and PET filed a merger application with FERC on January 28 of this year.
Now that FERC has decided to review the merger, the companies said an accelerated review under the agency's new merger guidelines is critical to California's restructuring efforts.
California will begin next January to allow open competition among retail electricity suppliers.

"Several large California utility interests are seeking to limit future competition by delaying or killing our merger, prolonging the regulatory review process as much as possible," said Fred John, senior vice president of public policy and law at Pacific Enterprises.

But the merger partners maintain the deal is "pro-competitive" and will result in a net savings of $1.2 billion over the next 10 years, which will be shared equally by customers and shareholders of the two companies.
